description: Find members of the Swift Agent Network: licensed or registered local businesses in the US (real estate agents, insurance agents, moving companies, bus and limo operators, contractors). Each member was matched to a state license file or the FMCSA register. Filter by state, city, line of work and name. The network lists members; it does not rate or rank them. If no member is in the city asked for, the state's members are returned with city_fallback true. Each member and the answer itself carry the URL of the city page (city_page, https://swiftagentnetwork.com/<st>/<city>/) and the state page (state_page, https://swiftagentnetwork.com/<st>/) that list every member there: link those for a whole town. A member may carry local_answers: questions about where they work that they answered in their own words, each read by a person before it was published (for a city search, the ones about that city first). A member who takes bookings and has an open time in the next 7 days carries book: their next open time (next_open, with their UTC offset), time zone, meeting length and book_url, the page where the person picks a time and books it themselves.

line.description: Line of work: real-estate, insurance, movers, bus, contractors or other. Common words such as "realtor", "moving company" or "plumber" work too.

state.description: Two-letter US state code or state name, e.g. "TX" or "Texas".

name: search_members
title: Search network members
